messages.subject: 6.0 - example data.
parts:
Hello all

Useful link for anyone working with/contemplating working with SNP
chips 6.0.
There is some test data available from
see http://www.broad.mit.edu/mpg/birdsuite/download.html
or direct link:
http://www.broad.mit.edu/mpg/birdsuite/downloads/birdsuite_inputs_1.4.tgz
This archive contains 6 .CEL files.
Very quick and easy to obtain.
Affymetrix have a link to 6.0 data but as far as I am aware, it is
only available on several DVDs that you need to request from them.

cheers

Lavinia.
